### FAQs on Complex Concepts

**Q: What is the fastest land animal in the world?**
A: The cheetah is the fastest land animal, capable of reaching speeds up to 70 mph (112 km/h) in short bursts.

**Q: How does the Internet of Things (IoT) work?**
A: IoT works by embedding electronics, software, sensors, and connectivity into physical devices (such as vehicles, home appliances, and other items). This allows these objects to connect to the internet and exchange data, enabling direct integration of the physical world into computer-based systems.
